title: Continuous rational realization of the raw constructible derived category
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime and let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, with valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a Noetherian finite-dimensional scheme $X$ on which $\ell$ is invertible, use its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], put $B_X=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/\varpi^n)_X$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and $E_X=B_X[1/\varpi]$, where localization is the sheaf colimit of repeated multiplication by $\varpi$. The sheaves $B_X$ and $E_X$ are canonically the continuous coefficient sheaves $U\mapsto C(|U|,A)$ and $U\mapsto C(|U|,E)$, respectively, with the finite-quotient constant-section normalizations. Use sheaves of modules and their ambient derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. An $E_X$-module sheaf is called constructible if on every member $S$ of some finite locally closed stratification [def-constructible-stratification] its restriction is pro-etale locally a finite free $E_S$-module, with finite rank allowed to vary. Let $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,E_X)$ be the full ambient derived subcategory of bounded complexes with such cohomology sheaves [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves].

The functor on integral representatives
$$J_X(QK)=E_X\otimes^L_{B_X}K,\qquad J_X(f/\varpi^n)=\varpi^{-n}J_X(f),$$
from the raw localization $D^b_c(X,E)$ [def-weil-pbc-rational-category] of the completed integral category with compatible etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], is an $E$-linear equivalence of triangulated categories onto $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,E_X)$. It identifies the bounded localized t-structure [prop-weil-localized-tstructure] with the ambient standard t-structure restricted to this subcategory, and its heart with the constructible $E_X$-module sheaves in degree zero. In particular $J_X(\mathcal H^r(QK))$ is the ordinary sheaf $E_X\otimes_{B_X}\mathcal H^r(K)$ in degree zero.

For a morphism $g:X'\to X$ between schemes satisfying these hypotheses, the completed pullback of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], extended to raw rationalizations, is carried by $J$ to ordinary derived module inverse image
$$\mathbb Lg^*_{E}(C)=E_{X'}\otimes^L_{g^{-1}E_X}g^{-1}C.$$
This comparison is natural and compatible with identity and composition of scheme morphisms and with finite coefficient-field extension $E\subset L$ and its associators. The composition comparisons here are those of these ambient derived module inverse images. For an etale morphism or locally closed immersion, $g^{-1}E_X\cong E_{X'}$ canonically and the module inverse image is the exact ordinary inverse image. For a pro-etale site object $U\to X$, restriction sends $E_X$ to $E_U$ and is the exact site-restriction functor; these identifications apply also to the restriction of the displayed ambient pullback. All coefficient comparisons are induced by the finite quotient maps, localization and the balanced tensor maps.
